_meta.description: Cannon unlock pricing for Unity Cloud Save 'cannon_stats' custom-id. Each top-level key (except _meta) is a Cloud Save sub-key whose value is the JSON DTO stored at that key.
_meta.applyInstructions: In the Unity Cloud Save dashboard, open the 'cannon_stats' custom-id. For each cannon sub-key listed below, MERGE the fields under that key into the existing JSON value: replace 'unlockAtChapter', 'baseCoinsRequired', and 'baseGemsRequired'. PRESERVE all gameplay stat fields (baseDamage, baseHealth, baseFireRate, baseBulletSpeed, baseCannonSpeed, displayName, description, maxUpgradeLevel) from the existing entry — do NOT overwrite them.
